sentences.text: (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY)

Accused Nos.2 to 6 are before this Court under Section 482 of Cr.P.C with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings as against them in crime No.18/2024 registered by Women Police Station, Yadgiri for the offences punishable under Sections 504, 506, 376(2)(n), 417, 114 read with Section 149 of IPC.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
3. FIR in crime No.18/2024 has been registered by Women Police Station, Yadigiri for the aforesaid offences against Mohommed Mateen and others on the basis of the first information dated 10.05.2024 submitted by the victim lady aged about 35 years.
Petitioners herein are arrayed as accused Nos.2 to 6 in the FIR.
Being aggrieved by the same the petitioners/accused Nos.2 to 6 are before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the victim is a married lady and her marriage has not been NC: 2025:KHC-K:111 dissolved.

Allegations in the first information is that she had a relationship with accused No.1 and accused Nos.2 to 6, who are the parents and siblings of accused No.1 have abused the first informant and also have criminally intimidated her stating that they will not allow accused No.1 to marry her.

He submits that accused No.1 and the victim lady apparently had a consensual relationship and for extraneous reasons the first informant/victim lady has filed a false complaint arraying the relatives of accused No.1 also as accused in the impugned criminal proceedings.
5. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the prayer made in the petition.

He submits that the investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against the petitioners for offences punishable under Sections 504, 506, 376(2)(n), 417, 114 read with Section 149 of IPC.
Accordingly, he prays to dismiss the petition.
Perusal of the material on record would go to show that the husband of the victim lady, aged about 35 years was working as a driver in the house of accused No.1 for the last about 14 years.
Accused No.1 appears to have developed an illicit relationship with the victim lady and they used to have sexual intercourse in the house of victim whenever her husband was not at home.
7. Perusal of the charge sheet would go to show that accused No.1 and the victim lady were in a relationship for the last several years.
Allegation now made by the victim lady is that accused No.1 used to have forcible sexual intercourse with her with an assurance of marrying her.

Allegation against the petitioners, who are arrayed as accused Nos.2 to 6 in the present case is that when the victim lady demanded accused No.1 to marry her, the accused Nos.2 to 6 have abused and criminally intimidated her and also informed her that they will not allow accused No.1 to marry her.

However,
the fact remains that the marriage of the victim lady with her first NC: 2025:KHC-K:111 husband is not dissolved and therefore, the question of the petitioners herein coming in the way of accused No.1 marrying the victim lady does not arise.

Even otherwise, the charge sheet material would go to show that accused No.1 and the victim lady had a relationship for the last several years and they used to Badesab And Ors vs The State And Anr on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82859795/
3 have sex in the house of victim lady whenever her husband had gone out of the house.

sentences.text: The relationship between accused No.1 and the victim lady appears to be consensual and therefore, a serious doubt arises whether the alleged offences get attracted against the petitioners.

Moreover, the fact remains that the marriage of the victim lady with her husband is still in subsistence and from the marriage the couple have children.
8.

Under the circumstances, I am of opinion that the continuation of the impugned criminal proceedings as against petitioners would not only amount to abuse of process of law, the same shall also put them to unnecessary hardship and embarrassment.
Therefore, to NC: 2025:KHC-K:111 secure the ends of justice, it is necessary to quash the impugned criminal proceedings as against the petitioners.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER a) Criminal petition is allowed.
b) The entire proceedings in crime No.18/2024 registered by Women Police Station,
Yadagiri for the offences punishable under Sections 504, 506, 376(2)(n), 417, 114 read with Section 149 of IPC, is hereby quashed as against the petitioners are concerned.

Sd/-
(S.VISHWAJITH SHETTY) JUDGE AMM CT:PK Badesab And Ors vs The State And Anr on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/82859795/
